Q36. What is the output of the following code?

    printf("Even");

    printf("Odd");
A) Even B) Odd ✅ C) EvenOdd D) Error

    i--;
// after loop
A) 2 B) 3 ✅ C) 4 D) Infinite

Q38. What will be the output of the following?

for(int i=0; i<4; i++) {
    if(i == 2) continue;
    printf("%d", i);
}
A) 0 1 2 3 B) 0 1 3 ✅ C) 0 1 2 D) 1 2 3

Q39. What is the output of the following switch?

int x = 2;

    case 1: printf("A");
    case 2: printf("B");
    case 3: printf("C");
    default: printf("D");
}
A) B B) B C D ✅ C) A B C D D) D

Q40. Which loop is best when you want to execute the body at least once?
